name: DDC handleDeductFee missing access control
summary: DDC's handleDeductFee(uint256,uint256,address,address) was callable by anyone and moved the fee amount out of an arbitrary holder, so the attacker deducted the whole DDC/USDT pair balance to themselves and sold it.
notes: The direct DDC runtime exposed handleDeductFee without caller authorization from deployment and remained byte-identical through exploitation.

The exploit receipt's USDT Transfer ledger shows 1.368537570861681076 USDT entering the DDC/USDT pair and 110,106.024385302142604310 USDT leaving it: 104,600.658160502419544245 USDT reached the attack contract and 5,505.366224799723060065 USDT went through the router to the fee recipient. Net pair depletion, and therefore gross victim loss after excluding the attacker's input, is 110,104.655847731280923234 USDT.
